title: E-FRC-0089: pure SU(3) gauge theory has a mass gap: the variational 0++ glueball mass, on a plateau from t = 0 to 2...
purpose: Experiment E-FRC-0089 in the gauge arena: pure SU(3) gauge theory has a mass gap: the variational 0++ glueball mass, on a plateau from t = 0 to 2, matches the published Wilson-action lattice mass at beta 5.7, and sits below the continuum m r0 = 4.21 by the known scalar dip of a coarse lattice.
known_limitations: Depth L2 (L2: known physics reproduced on a stated model).
